entries.name: the woman at the station
lines: real. wire-thin. nobody looks at her.

entries.name: the fixer
lines: I owe him one favour. he didn't say what.

entries.name: athena's note
lines: athena left before i arrived. she says she is fine.
she wants me to say she was home, listening to loud music.
why shouldn't co know she went out?

entries.name: times and gaps
lines: repeating intervals. did she watch the drones and guardians?
avoiding one patrol couldn't hide someone from the whole city.

entries.name: who ran the radio shop before Care?
make it promise, don't just ask.
old portable computer
lines: radio repair has a receipt for athena's portable computer.
is it still there? why wasn't she using co-net?
